projects.qa.focus.recipeError: Could not generate this execution Recipe.
projects.qa.focus.executionQueued: Execution queued for the selected Runner.

projects.qa.focus.title: Tests
projects.qa.focus.subtitle: One test, its results, and a clear next step.
projects.qa.focus.connectionsNote: Saved connections are credentials for integrations, not a count of agents running now.
projects.qa.focus.signInBody: Sign in to organize checklists, runs, evidence, and human review.
projects.qa.focus.newProjectBody: Your project keeps instructions, memory, and files together for each test.
projects.qa.focus.helpBody: Choose a checklist, approve an exact run, then review the recorded results and evidence. Agents execute; Oddpath keeps the record.
projects.qa.focus.sampleNote: Read-only sample · Nothing is written to your project.
projects.qa.focus.advisoryAssessment: This checklist assessment is advisory. It is separate from the required execution Recipe review.
projects.qa.focus.proofNote: Attaching the required entries only clears the structural evidence gate. It does not verify the requested content or mean the checks passed.
projects.qa.focus.missingBody: The executing agent must submit evidence linked to these requirements. This view does not upload evidence.
projects.qa.focus.runEvidenceBody: Evidence not linked to a check is kept here.
projects.qa.focus.reviewTitle: Approve the QA record, not the release.
projects.qa.focus.reviewBody: A failed check can still be accurately documented. Approval confirms the record and its evidence, not release readiness.
projects.qa.focus.selectionNote: Runner and Recipe compatibility is checked in Prepare run. A newer Recipe does not replace your choice automatically.
projects.qa.focus.profilesError: Runner profiles could not be loaded. Retry discovery; this does not mean no Runner exists.
projects.qa.focus.loadError: Could not load this test. Try refreshing.
projects.qa.focus.externalEvidenceNote: External link · not stored by Oddpath
projects.qa.focus.next.loadingBody: Actions will be available when this record is loaded.
projects.qa.focus.next.busyBody: Please wait before starting another action.
projects.qa.focus.next.loadFailedBody: Retry loading before acting on this record.
projects.qa.focus.next.emptyBody: Describe what you want to verify. Oddpath keeps its checklist, results, and evidence together.
projects.qa.focus.next.sampleBody: This is a read-only example. Create a real test when you are ready; nothing here starts an execution.
projects.qa.focus.next.generatingBody: Oddpath is working in the background. This view updates automatically.
projects.qa.focus.next.generationFailedB: The failed attempt is preserved. Inspect the error below; you can create a new test without changing this record.
projects.qa.focus.next.awaitingChecklist: A connected agent can submit a checklist through MCP or REST for you to inspect and select.
projects.qa.focus.next.reviewingChecklis: The advisory assessment is in progress. No execution has started.
projects.qa.focus.next.checklistReadyBod: Inspect the expected checks below. Selecting a checklist locks the version; it does not start a run.
projects.qa.focus.next.checklistReviewFa: The owner may still inspect and select this checklist. Execution Recipe review remains a separate required gate.
projects.qa.focus.next.preparingBody: Choose a Runner and a reviewed Recipe, then approve the exact run. Opening setup starts nothing automatically.
projects.qa.focus.next.changesRequestedB: Review the feedback in History before preparing another approved run.
projects.qa.focus.next.runningBody: The selected Runner is processing this approved run. Results update here.
projects.qa.focus.next.externalRunningBo: The agent records results and evidence through its connection. Refresh to load its latest updates.
projects.qa.focus.next.executionFailedBo: Inspect the recorded failure below. Another run is available only when the current test state allows it.
projects.qa.focus.next.executionCancelle: Partial results and history remain available. A new run still requires its own approval.
projects.qa.focus.next.evidenceBody: Open the first missing requirement to see what the executing agent must provide.
projects.qa.focus.next.reviewBody: Results and required evidence are recorded. Review the record before deciding; nothing is approved automatically.
projects.qa.focus.next.approvedBody: This approval confirms the recorded results and evidence. It is not permission to release.
projects.qa.focus.next.resultsBody: Inspect the recorded checks and evidence below.
projects.qa.focus.next.unavailableBody: Refresh this record to load the latest available action.
projects.qa.focus.execution.CLAIMEDBody: The Runner is validating the approved Recipe and local profile.
projects.qa.focus.execution.RUNNINGBody: The Runner is recording results and required evidence.
projects.qa.focus.execution.SUCCEEDEDBod: Execution finished. Inspect the check outcomes and evidence below.
projects.qa.focus.execution.FAILEDBody: The Runner could not complete this execution.
projects.qa.focus.execution.CANCELLEDBod: Partial results and history are preserved.
projects.context.title: Project context · {project}
projects.integrations.title: Integrations
projects.integrations.note: Manage this project's tool access and test workers separately.
projects.integrations.toolsNote: External tools connect to Oddpath through MCP or REST. Saved credentials do not indicate that an agent is online.
projects.integrations.runnersNote: A Runner executes only approved work. Connection tokens and live Runner status are separate.
projects.integrations.noProfiles: No Runner profiles discovered. Connect and start a Runner to register its public profiles.
projects.connections.title: Project access
projects.connections.errorCopy: Copy failed. Select the value manually.
projects.connections.endpointNote: Works with Codex, Claude, and any client that supports remote Streamable HTTP MCP.
projects.connections.agentNote: Codex, Claude, or another MCP client submits QA work.
projects.connections.runnerNote: A local worker executes approved Recipes with local profile values.
projects.connections.name: Connection name
projects.connections.revealNote: Oddpath stores only its hash. You will not be able to reveal it again.
projects.connections.mcpNote: Paste this into the MCP client you use. Client-specific file locations can differ.
projects.connections.runnerExistingNote: An offline Runner usually needs its local process restarted, not a new connection or Recipe.
projects.connections.runnerExistingToken: Use the token you saved when this connection was created. The token cannot be shown again in Oddpath.
projects.connections.runnerExistingStart: Open PowerShell at the repository root, enter the token at the masked prompt below, and keep the Runner terminal open.
projects.connections.runnerExistingLost: Lost the token? Only then create a new Runner connection and update the local configuration. Creating a token does not start the Runner.
projects.connections.runnerSecurePrompt: The PowerShell prompt hides the token and keeps it out of the command history. Save the token privately for future restarts.
projects.connections.runnerConfigure: Adjust the profile URL and local values, then set the token in your terminal. Reuse an existing working configuration instead of overwriting it.
projects.connections.runnerStart: Install the configured browser once, then start the Runner from the repository root:
projects.connections.runnerPrivacy: The token and profile values stay on the machine running Playwright. Oddpath stores only the public profile manifest.
projects.connections.runnerPermission: Claim only owner-approved executions, run the exact immutable Recipe, and return results plus required evidence. It cannot select checklists or approve QA records.
projects.connections.agentPermission: Read QA Requests, submit checklist and Recipe candidates, start connected-agent runs, record results, and attach evidence. Checklist selection and Human Review stay owner-only in Oddpath.
projects.connections.empty: No saved connections for this project yet.
projects.qa.operations.historyNote: These attempts are preserved in the record. Newer attempts appear above; an earlier failure does not describe the latest result.
projects.qa.operations.earlierFailure: Earlier attempt failed ({code}). See the newer attempt above for its status.
projects.qa.operations.earlierNote: Earlier attempt preserved for reference. See the newer attempt above for its status.
projects.qa.operations.failedCode: Oddpath could not finish this operation ({code}).
projects.qa.operations.failed: Oddpath could not finish this operation.
projects.qa.runSetup.title: Start a local development Runner
projects.qa.runSetup.reconnectTitle: Runner offline — start the one you already connected
projects.qa.runSetup.reconnectNote: Your reviewed Recipe is preserved. Reconnect the existing Runner; do not create a new token just because it is offline.
projects.qa.runSetup.securePrompt: Enter your saved token at the masked PowerShell prompt. The command does not contain the token.
projects.qa.runSetup.stepTerminal: Open PowerShell at your project repository root. Keep the API and web running.
projects.qa.runSetup.stepConfig: Keep your existing apps/runner/oddpath.runner.json; do not overwrite it.
projects.qa.runSetup.stepToken: Run the command below and enter your saved token at its hidden prompt. Never paste it in chat or source files.
projects.qa.runSetup.offlineNote: This profile is saved, but its Runner is not sending heartbeats. A saved connection does not mean the Runner process is running.
projects.qa.runSetup.terminal: For this repository's local setup, keep the API and web terminals open. Open a third PowerShell terminal at the repository root.
projects.qa.runSetup.config: Reuse your existing {config}; do not overwrite a working configuration.
projects.qa.runSetup.token: In that same terminal, set the environment variable named by {setting} in your configuration (default: {variable}) to your Runner connection token. Keep the token out of chats, screenshots, and source files.
projects.qa.runSetup.refresh: Keep this terminal running. Once the Runner reports that it is connected, choose Refresh here. Refresh only reads Runner status; it does not start the process.
projects.qa.runSetup.preserveRecipe: Do not regenerate a reviewed Recipe just because the Runner is offline. Oddpath checks profile compatibility again when it reconnects.
projects.qa.approval.queueing: Queueing this approved execution. Wait for confirmation.
projects.qa.approval.generating: Wait for Recipe generation and review to finish before approving a run.
projects.qa.approval.reviewPending: Recipe review is in progress. Approval stays unavailable until it finishes.
projects.qa.approval.reviewFailed: This Recipe's review failed. Open its details and choose Retry review; approval requires a usable completed review.
projects.qa.approval.reviewMissing: Choose a reviewed Recipe. An unreviewed revision cannot be approved for execution.
projects.qa.approval.profileMissing: Connect and start a Runner, then choose its profile in the run details.
projects.qa.approval.profileOffline: Start the selected Runner using the setup guidance, then refresh its status. It must be Online before queueing.
projects.qa.approval.profileIncompatible: Choose a compatible Runner. This Runner does not support the required Recipe protocol.
projects.qa.approval.recipeMissing: Generate or select an Execution Recipe, then wait for its review.
projects.qa.approval.profileMismatch: This Recipe does not match the selected Runner profile version. Choose a compatible reviewed revision, or generate and review a new one.
projects.qa.approval.reviewRequired: Inspect the Recipe, then select the review confirmation checkbox.
projects.qa.approval.productionRequired: This profile targets PRODUCTION. Select the separate production confirmation to authorize this run.
projects.qa.approval.ready: Ready to queue this exact Recipe on the selected Runner.
projects.qa.operations.recipeOutputInval: The AI returned an incompatible Recipe. This operation did not start an execution. Open Run with Playwright and generate a new Recipe.
projects.qa.operations.recipeReviewInval: The AI returned an unusable Recipe review. This operation did not start an execution. Open Run with Playwright, select this Recipe, and choose Retry review.
projects.qa.reviewRetry.note: The review failed, but this Recipe is preserved. Retry its review without generating a new revision or starting an execution. An online Runner is not required.
projects.qa.reviewRetry.pendingNote: Oddpath is reviewing this Recipe. Approval is unavailable until the review completes successfully.
projects.qa.reviewRetry.started: Recipe review queued. The Recipe and its failed review are preserved; no execution has started.
projects.qa.reviewRetry.error: Could not retry this Recipe review.
projects.qa.reviewRetry.invalidReceipt: Oddpath returned an invalid review operation receipt.
